meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'оображать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'understand, use one’s head'.

examples.trans: You saved me. That was quick thinking.

examples.text: Это слово «соображать» часто звучит в разговоре.

present есть; у меня есть = I have

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'слуга'). Common feminine noun meaning 'service, favor' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I don't forget favors like that.

examples.text: Я такие важные услуги никогда не забываю.
examples.trans: I never forget such important services.
Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.en: by the way, speaking of which

examples.trans: Oh, by the way, I almost forgot.

examples.text: Кстати, если хочешь, иди к нам в команду. Шансы у нас огромные.
examples.trans: By the way, if you want, join our team. Our chances are huge.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'давать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'pass on, send'.

examples.text: А, кстати, та девушка ничего мне не передавала?
examples.trans: By the way, did that girl leave a message for me?

examples.text: Это слово «передавать» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'pass on' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нятие'). Common neuter noun meaning 'concept, idea, notion' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I have no idea at all.

meanings.note: mostly in set phrases: иметь совесть, иметь право = to have the right; everyday 'I have' is у меня есть
